title: Murmur | Use the compute you already have
excerpt: Run heavy Python math on the Macs and Windows PCs you already own, against a deadline you set. Your scripts and data stay on your machines.
content_html:
Every device you own is already paid for. Murmur turns that sunk cost into capacity — without new hardware or sending your scripts or data to anyone.

What Murmur does for you

Use the computers you own. Keep your work on them.

You already own the hardware. Murmur makes it do the work you’re currently paying someone else for.

Spend less

Stop renting computers you already have. Murmur runs work on your own Macs and PCs. Opt-in cloud capacity is on the roadmap.

How you payFree on up to 10 devices, no card. Beyond that, $10 a month per device up to 20, then $5 a month per device up to 50. Pricing →

On the roadmap

Private AI, on your premises

Run capable AI models on your own machines — even models too big for any one of them. Murmur splits a model across several ordinary computers so they work as one. Your prompts, code and documents stay inside.

DemonstratedA 14-billion-parameter coding model across two consumer graphics cards, neither big enough to hold it alone.

Math, not your script

Workers receive math operations, not your script, and only devices joined to your own server get work. Stronger fragments-only protection is on the roadmap.

How it works

Computational logistics: every job, on the right machine.

FedEx didn’t invent the airplane or the truck. It built the network that could promise “there by morning.”

Murmur does the same for compute. It decides, piece by piece, where each part of a job should run — on the fewest of your own devices that can meet the deadline. The promise: this workload, done by this deadline.

01

Decompose

Your workload is broken into small, self-contained math operations and wired into a graph. That graph is the package — we don’t need to understand your science or your business to move it.

→ what is the work?

02

Place

For every piece, Murmur works out where it could run and where it should: on the fewest of your devices that can meet the deadline.

→ where does it go?

03

Deliver

Work goes to devices that are awake and ready. When a worker goes offline, its share is reassigned.

→ is it moving?

04

Reassemble

Results come back and are put together into your final output. You see the answer and the deadline met — not the thousands of pieces behind it.

→ is it done?

See workloads and how to get started →

Pricing

Free to start. Your hardware, your savings.

You already paid for the machines. Murmur puts them to work, free on up to 10 devices. Pay only when you outgrow that: a flat monthly price per device, with no metered cloud bill on top.

Freeup to 10 devices

No card, no time limit

  • Devices 11–20: $10 / month each
  • Devices 21–50: $5 / month each
  • More than 50 devices? Contact us
  • Heavy compute on your own machines; private AI on the roadmap
  • Apple-silicon Macs and Windows PCs today; other devices on the roadmap

Get started

Start free on the licence page. Add devices any time; you keep your devices.

Get started

Be first to run Murmur.

Install Murmur by asking your AI assistant. Your AI agent does the setup; you sign in and start free.

Ask your AI assistant

Give it this one line:

“Install Murmur by following https://cdn.murmurcomputing.ai/START-HERE.md”

Get started

Already set up? Sign in.
